violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

violation_type.typical_finding: Director did not have a current transportation training.

finding_variants.text: Director did not have a current transportation training.
A caregiver in charge of transportation did not have a current transportation training.
A caregiver was observed transporting the children in care and does not have transportation training.
Transportation safety training was not available for review for the director and the 4 other employees that transport children.
Six staff training records were reviewed. One staff member last completed transportation on 12/2020.
Transportation training is not current for any current staff that transport children in care and the director of the operation additionally requires transportation training.
